about: The SVG this renderer draws for the marks Mermaid 11 draws and it once drew plain: every sequence participant type, every half, two-way and central-connection message, every flowchart shape with no bracket form, and the lollipop ends of a class relations panel. Compared with Mermaid by shape class; these are the bytes.

cases.source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant B@{ "type": "boundary" }
    participant C@{ "type": "control" }
    participant E@{ "type": "entity" }
    participant D@{ "type": "database" }
    participant L@{ "type": "collections" }
    participant Q@{ "type": "queue" }
    B-|\C: half-top
    C-|/E: half-bottom
    E-\\D: stick-top
    D-//L: stick-bottom
    L/|-Q: half-top-rev
    Q-|\L: half-top RtoL
    L//-D: stick-top-rev
    D<<->>E: both
    C<<-->>B: both dotted
    B()->>()C: central both
    C->>()D: central to
    D()->>E: central from
    Q->>Q: self
    Q/|-Q: self rev
